description: This file defines the 'CurrentVersionDetailsController' class, which extends an abstract installer Vue controller and manages the pre-rendering setup for a version details screen within the installer upgrade process of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: CurrentVersionDetailsController
classes.description: Controller class for handling the current version details view within the installer upgrade process.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to set up the component for the current version screen and update the state container to reflect the current screen.
